summary: Sheltered post-apocalyptic survival-management entries, focused on the PC route for archive capture and current storefront clarity.

entries.title: Sheltered

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Sheltered is a post-apocalyptic survival-management game from Unicube and Team17. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, and console and mobile routes exist as well. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it has the clearest active storefront, achievements/cloud support, desktop controls, and the best capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for the main archive route. Use console or mobile versions only for comparison captures.

entries.remaster_caveats: Sheltered 2 is a separate sequel, not a replacement for the original game.

entries.title: Sheltered 2

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Sheltered 2 is documented on Steam as a Windows-only survival management sequel from Unicube and Team17. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is both the complete route and the archive capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release. Treat the Sheltered Double Pack as a convenience bundle with the first game, not a gameplay-complete edition.

entries.remaster_caveats: Sequel to Sheltered, not DLC or a remaster of the first game.
